reasons: The appeal was lodged in 2025 and decided on 10 September 2026 under the Court's appellate procedural framework.
The dispute concerns judicial review within the European Union legal order.
D&A Pharma was the appellant and EMA the respondent in the Court of Justice appeal.
The narrow observation concerns appellate admissibility, interest in bringing proceedings and the legal consequences of the General Court order, not medicinal-product scientific merits.
The Court of Justice exercised appellate jurisdiction over the General Court order.

reasoning: Applicability is limited to the appellate-procedure proposition resolved by C-467/25 P and does not convert the judgment into a scientific or marketing-authorisation merits ruling.
